question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Astound
solution:
The correct answer is '**Clarify**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Astound**' is '**Clarify**'.
 
• **Astound**: to surprise somebody very much. (भौंचक्‍का या आश्‍चर्यचकित कर देना)
 
 
• *Example: We were **astounded** by how well he performed.*
 
 
 
• **Clarify**: to make something become clear and easier to understand. (किसी प्रसंग को स्‍पष्‍ट और सुबोध बनाना; स्‍पष्‍टीकरण करना)
 
 
• *Example: I hope that what I say will **clarify** the situation.***
 
 
 

Correct Answer:__** *Clarify.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Confuse**: to make somebody unable to think clearly or to know what to do. (उलझन में डाल देना; गड़बड़ा या चकरा देना; सोच-विचार में दुविधा पैदा करना)
 
• **Stun**: to make a person or animal unconscious or confused, especially by hitting him/her/it on the head. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या पशु को बेहोश कर देना या चकरा देना (विशेषतः उसके सिर पर मारकर); अचेत कर देना)
 
• **Shock**: the feeling that you get when something unpleasant happens suddenly; the situation that causes this feeling. (एकाएक अप्रिय घटना घट जाने से उत्‍पन्‍न मनःस्थिति, झटका, आघात, सदमा, धक्‍का; इस मनःस्थिति को उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाली परिस्थिति)
